title: Grid reorder acceptance
focus: Finish actual reorder touch/keyboard/cancel/non-drag and sorting/filter/page policy successors. Preserve current processing model, distinguish physical touch from emulation, add focused regression/fix proposals.

originalChecklistStatements.A-M-18: - [ ] A-M-18 Reconcile AppDataGridRowDnd final acceptance: Replace DOM selectors/ghost styling; keyboard/touch/reorder/cancel behavior. Link its `F-C18`, `T-C18` and `V-C18` evidence and any unresolved defects.
originalChecklistStatements.A-G-17: - [ ] A-G-17 Reconcile original `G-17`: Define row reordering for pointer, touch, keyboard and non-drag actions; announce changes, support cancel, and define behavior when sorting/filtering/pagination is active. Historical status: open.

A-M-18.originalChecklistText: - [ ] A-M-18 Reconcile AppDataGridRowDnd final acceptance: Replace DOM selectors/ghost styling; keyboard/touch/reorder/cancel behavior. Link its `F-C18`, `T-C18` and `V-C18` evidence and any unresolved defects.

successors.deliverable: On a named physical touch device/browser, exercise long-press drag before/after, outside/Escape-equivalent cancellation, invalidated rows and host failure rollback; record no callback on cancel, exact single callback on commit, order and focus. Preserve existing Move alternative. Retain spoken drag announcements under the separate AT acceptance gate; do not substitute source or emulated taps.

A-M-18.limits: Accept only the original bounded criterion and explicit input/host/engine limits in the report. No inferred production/device/AT/legal approval.

A-G-17.originalChecklistText: - [ ] A-G-17 Reconcile original `G-17`: Define row reordering for pointer, touch, keyboard and non-drag actions; announce changes, support cancel, and define behavior when sorting/filtering/pagination is active. Historical status: open.

successors.ownerOrPrerequisite: Physical touch device and named AT operator; coordinator source/host snapshot
successors.deliverable: Exercise long-press start/move/cancel/drop, spoken source/drop-position/commit-request versus saved order, and cross-grid cancellation with colliding IDs. Reuse existing pointer/Move checks.
successors.acceptanceEvidence: Device/browser/AT versions, actual gesture/event trace, no host request on cancellation and unchanged sibling state; retain explicit sorting/filter/page boundary evidence.

A-G-17.limits: Accept only the original bounded criterion and explicit input/host/engine limits in the report. No inferred production/device/AT/legal approval.
